name: Facilitating Families Counseling
defaultDescription: Facilitating Families Counseling, LLC. Therapy for eating disorders, couples and families, individual support, and trauma. Serving Minnesota, Wisconsin, Wyoming, Idaho, and Utah.
crisisLine: If you are in crisis or thinking about suicide, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline), available 24/7. If you are in immediate danger, call 911.
